content.short: Spritz is a crypto payments app to pay real-world bills, off-ramp to a bank and spend with a Visa card.
content.description: Spritz is a crypto payments app that lets people use stablecoins and crypto for real-world expenses without first cashing out to a bank. From their own wallet, US users can pay more than 6,000 types of bills, off-ramp crypto to their bank account, buy crypto with a bank transfer, and spend through a Visa card. Spritz supports assets held across many networks, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, BNB Chain, Optimism, Sui, Tron and XRP, covering tens of thousands of tokens. Registered with FinCEN and licensed as a money transmitter, it targets crypto holders who want to live off their holdings by turning digital assets into everyday spending power.
content.meta: Spritz lets you pay real-world bills and spend directly from crypto and stablecoins. Discover Spritz and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
